rho_reference.order_note: IC above the best matched rho at w = 0, 0.1 and 1 in 120 of 120 arm-cells (minimum IC/rho 2.325, 7.616, 40.156). IC also exceeds every rho variant (plain, negation, automorphism) at w = 0 and w = 1 in every arm-cell (minimum 1.16), and each total is linear in w, so the order holds for every w in [0, 1], including any calibrated weight w_cal and 10 w_cal up to 1; no w_cal was recorded (the run predates the 2026-11-12 calibrated-weight rule).
